label: Mastra
description: The workflow becomes a TypeScript Mastra flow: an async function for each block, Mastra Agents (an AI SDK model, createTool tools, a Zod schema for typed answers) for the AI blocks, and a FLOW that AgentCanvas's flow engine (in TypeScript) runs as the canvas draws it. Any catalog model works, and tool calls can wait for a person's approval (Mastra's own requireApproval, which suspends the agent's run). Runs need Node.js 22.18+ and Mastra on the server (`make mastra`); designing and exporting do not. Exports are TypeScript projects that Node.js runs as they are. No saved history, state editing or breakpoints; a paused run lives in memory.

notes.core.set: an async function that returns the fields it sets
notes.core.router: the flow engine follows the first route whose CEL rule matches (generated orchestration: the flow does not use Mastra's createWorkflow yet)
notes.core.join: the flow engine waits for every branch before the block runs
notes.core.approval: the run pauses and is saved as JSON; it continues from that step when a person answers
notes.core.human_input: the run pauses and asks again when an answer does not fit
notes.core.script: your workspace function (Python) is called from the flow: on the server inside AgentCanvas, with python3 in exports
notes.knowledge.search: the flow searches the knowledge base; exports search its file with the built-in embedder (with python3)
notes.core.llm: a Mastra Agent with the block's model, asked once with agent.generate
notes.core.agent: a Mastra Agent (instructions, an AI SDK model, createTool tools, structuredOutput with a Zod schema); tools named in 'Ask before using' get requireApproval: the agent's run suspends, its snapshot is saved with the pause, and it continues with approveToolCallGenerate or declineToolCallGenerate once a person approves, edits or rejects the call (one call per pause)
notes.mw.model_call_limit: Mastra's own maxSteps: past the limit the agent stops with a note, or the run fails when the block says so
notes.tool.python: your workspace tool (Python) runs on the server inside AgentCanvas, and with python3 in exports
